name: Parley
description: Parley (formerly Sidekick) PWA backend — exposes the /v1/* OpenAI-Responses contract the parley proxy expects against any openclaw runtime. Plugin id 'parley' (flipped from the legacy 'sidekick' key in the 2026-08 identity purge).

authToken.description: Shared bearer token the parley proxy uses for HTTP auth. Optional; the proxy works without auth in dev.
